match.id.long: A unique, non-null sequential identifier for each football match, ranging from 1 to 25979 and formatted as a 4-digit zero-padded or character-represented integer string.

match.iwa.long: Decimal betting odds offered by Interwetten (IW) for an away win (A). Values in this column are decimal numbers represented as REAL types, ranging from 1.1 to 25.0, with approximately 13% of the matches containing NULL values.

match.iwd.long: This column stores the betting odds offered by the bookmaker Interwetten for a match resulting in a draw (IWD). The values are stored as decimal numbers representing decimal odds, ranging from 1.5 to 11.0, with approximately 13% of the matches containing missing (NULL) odds data.

match.iwh.long: Decimal odds offered by bookmaker Interwetten (IW) for a home team win (H). This numeric column ranges from 1.03 to 20.0, with approximately 13% of values being NULL.

match.lba.long: Represents the decimal betting odds for an away team win (LBA) offered by the bookmaker Ladbrokes. Values are decimal numbers stored as REAL, ranging from 1.1 to 51.0, with approximately 13% of matches containing missing entries.

match.lbd.short: Ladbrokes betting odds for a draw
match.lbd.long: This column contains decimal betting odds offered by Ladbrokes (LB) for a draw (D) outcome in a football match. Values are stored as real numbers ranging from 1.4 to 19.0, with a notable density of entries around typical draw odds such as 3.2, 3.3, and 3.4.

match.lbh.long: Decimal odds for a home team win offered by the bookmaker Ladbrokes (LBH). This is a real number ranging from 1.04 to 26.0, with approximately 13% of matches missing this betting data.

match.league_id.short: Unique identifier for the football league
match.league_id.long: An integer identifier referencing the specific football league in which the match was played. This column contains no null values and features 11 distinct league IDs ranging from 1 to 24558.

match.match_api_id.long: Column "match_api_id" (declared type INTEGER). No NULLs across 25979 rows. All 25979 non-NULL values are distinct (unique). Values are exactly 6 characters long, all digits, always beginning with "483". Ranges from "483129" to "2216672".

match.possession.long: An XML block tracking ball possession percentages for the home and away teams key-framed at specific minutes throughout the match. Each record includes elapsed match time, home/away possession rates, and metadata representing real-time event updates.

match.psa.short: Pinnacle Sports away win betting odds
match.psa.long: This column contains decimal betting odds for an away team victory, provided by the bookmaker Pinnacle Sports (indicated by the 'PSA' prefix representing Pinnacle Sports Away). It holds real numbers ranging from 1.09 to 47.5, with about 57% of the records containing NULL values.

match.psd.long: Decimal betting odds for a draw outcome in a football match, as opening or closing market prices from the bookmaker Pinnacle Sports (PS). Values are real numbers ranging from 2.2 to 29.0, with a high percentage of missing data (57%).

match.psh.short: Pinnacle Sports home win betting odds
match.psh.long: This column contains decimal betting odds for a home team victory, offered by the bookmaker Pinnacle Sports (PSH stands for Pinnacle Sports Home). The values are real numbers ranging from 1.04 to 36.0, represented as decimal strings, with roughly 57% of the records being NULL.

match.season.short: Football season of the match in YYYY/YYYY format
match.season.long: Identifies the European football season during which the match was played, formatted as a nine-character 'YYYY/YYYY' string. It contains eight distinct seasonal values ranging from '2008/2009' to '2015/2016' with no NULLs.

match.shotoff.short: XML data containing match events for shots off target
match.shotoff.long: An XML-formatted log representing all occurrences of shots off target (shotoffs) during a match. Each record details multiple incidents with structured elements including the elapsed time, subtype of shot (e.g., header, distance, big chance post), player ID, team ID, and unique incident IDs.

match.shoton.short: XML detailing shots on target and blocked shots
match.shoton.long: An XML-structured column documenting each shot on target or blocked shot event in a match. Individual event records within the XML root `<shoton>` contain details such as game minutes (`<elapsed>`, `<elapsed_plus>`), the executing player (`<player1>`), the team ID (`<team>`), the coordinates, shot sub-type, and result statistics.

match.sja.short: Stan James bookmaker betting odds for an away win
match.sja.long: Decimal betting odds offered by bookmaker Stan James (SJ) for an away team victory (A). The values are real numbers ranging from 1.1 to 41.0, with approximately 34% of the matches containing NULL values.

match.sjd.short: Stan James betting odds for a draw
match.sjd.long: Represents the decimal betting odds for a draw match outcome, offered by the bookmaker Stan James (SJ). Values are real numbers ranging from 1.4 to 15.0, with roughly 34% of the rows containing NULL values.

match.sjh.short: Stan James bookmaker betting odds for a home win
match.sjh.long: Represents the decimal betting odds for a home team victory as published by the Stan James bookmaker. Values in this column range from 1.04 to 23.0, with approximately 34% of the match records containing NULL values.

match.stage.short: Round or matchday number of the football season
match.stage.long: Represents the specific round or matchday of the league season, ranging from 1 to 38. There are no missing values, and each of the 38 distinct stages contains an equal distribution of exactly 740 match records.

match.vca.short: BetVictor betting odds for an away team win
match.vca.long: Decimal betting odds for an away team victory (A) offered by the bookmaker BetVictor (formerly Victor Chandler). Values are real numbers ranging from 1.08 to 67.0, with approximately 13% of rows containing missing (NULL) values.

match.vcd.short: VC Bet decimal odds for a draw
match.vcd.long: Represents the decimal betting odds offered by VC Bet (Victor Chandler) for a draw result in a football match, ranging from 1.62 to 26.0.

match.vch.short: VC Bet away win betting odds
match.vch.long: Decimal odds for an away win (H) offered by the bookmaker VC Bet (Victor Chandler). Values are stored as real numbers ranging from 1.03 to 36.0, with approximately 13% of records containing null values where odds were not recorded.

match.wha.short: William Hill away win betting odds
match.wha.long: Decimal betting odds offered by William Hill (WH) for an away team win (A). Values are decimal numbers stored as floats, ranging from 1.08 to 51.0, with roughly 13% of matches missing this bookmaker data.

match.whd.long: Decimal betting odds for a draw, offered by the bookmaker William Hill (WH). Values range from 1.02 to 17.0, with common draw odds clustered around 3.1 to 3.5.

match.whh.short: William Hill decimal betting odds for a home team win
match.whh.long: This column contains the decimal betting odds published by bookmaker William Hill (WH) for a home team victory (H). Numeric values range from 1.02 to 26.0, with approximately 13% of matches containing NULL values.

player.birthday.short: Player's date of birth in datetime format
player.birthday.long: This column records the player's date of birth, stored as a 19-character text string in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' with the time portion defaulted to '00:00:00'. Values are populated for all records, ranging from January 23, 1967 to April 24, 1999.

player.height.long: The height of the player in centimeters, ranging from 157.48 to 208.28. Although declared as an INTEGER, the column contains decimal values that correspond to standard conversions from feet and inches.

player.id.short: Unique identifier for a football player
player.id.long: The unique primary key for each player in the database, containing non-null sequential integer values ranging from 1 to 11075. This column is ideal for joining player records with performance attributes or match statistics.

player.player_api_id.short: Unique numeric identifier for players in the database
player.player_api_id.long: A unique, non-null 4-to-5-digit integer serving as the primary identifier for each football player in the database. It is used to join player records with match and performance statistics tables.

player.player_fifa_api_id.short: Unique FIFA API identifier for the player
player.player_fifa_api_id.long: The unique integer identifier of the player within the EA Sports FIFA video game API, ranging from 2 to 234141 with no null values.

player.player_name.short: Full name of the football player
player.player_name.long: This column contains the full name of the professional football player, with text values ranging from 4 to 25 characters. There are no NULL values, and while most names are unique, some common football names like 'Danilo' or 'Paulinho' appear multiple times.

player.weight.long: The weight of the player in pounds, recorded as a three-digit integer ranging from 117 to 243 without any missing values.

player_attributes.acceleration.short: player acceleration rating on a scale from 10 to 97
player_attributes.acceleration.long: An integer rating representing a football player's acceleration attribute, ranging from 10 to 97. The values are stored as two-digit strings, with approximately 0.5% of rows containing NULL values.

player_attributes.aggression.short: Player aggression rating on a 1-to-100 scale
player_attributes.aggression.long: An integer rating representing a football player's level of aggression, ranging from 6 to 97. It is typically scaled from 1 to 100, is null for 836 rows, and is commonly used to assess a player's play style and defensive physical presence.

player_attributes.agility.short: Player agility rating on a scale from 11 to 96
player_attributes.agility.long: An integer rating representing a football player's agility, ranging from 11 to 96. Approximately 1% of the records have NULL values for this attribute.

player_attributes.attacking_work_rate.long: A categorical rating of a football player's offensive effort level, predominantly consisting of 'medium', 'high', and 'low' values, with some minor variations such as 'norm' and 'None'.

player_attributes.balance.long: An integer rating representing the player's stability and physical balance, ranging from 12 to 96, where higher values indicate better equilibrium under pressure.

player_attributes.ball_control.long: An integer rating from 5 to 97 representing a player's ball control ability as observed in European football matches. This column contains null values for roughly 0.5% of rows, with the remaining values distributed as 1- to 2-digit numerical scores.

player_attributes.crossing.short: Player crossing skill rating from 1 to 95
player_attributes.crossing.long: An integer attribute rating a soccer player's crossing ability on a scale from 1 to 95. Values are represented as one- or two-digit integers, with approximately 0.5% of rows containing NULL values.

player_attributes.curve.long: An integer rating between 2 and 94 representing a player's ability to curve the ball, sourced from FIFA video game attributes. This column contains NULL values for approximately 1% of the records.

player_attributes.date.short: Date and time when player attributes were recorded
player_attributes.date.long: The timestamp indicating when the player's attributes were updated or evaluated, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. It includes 197 distinct dates spanning from '2007-02-22 00:00:00' to '2016-07-07 00:00:00', with no null values.

player_attributes.defensive_work_rate.long: Column "defensive_work_rate" (declared type TEXT). 836 of 183978 rows are NULL (0%). 19 distinct values. Values are 1–6 characters long, mixed characters. Ranges from "0" to "tocky". Most common: "medium" (130846), "high" (27041), "low" (18432), "_0" (2394), "o" (1550).

player_attributes.dribbling.long: An integer rating from 1 to 97 representing a player's technical dribbling ability, where higher values indicate superior ball control. This metric is typically sourced from sports video game attributes such as FIFA.

player_attributes.finishing.short: Player finishing rating on a 1-97 scale
player_attributes.finishing.long: An integer attribute rating a player's finishing ability, generally stored on a 1 to 100 scale (with an observed range of 1 to 97 in this dataset). This column contains approximately 0.5% null values (836 rows) and is commonly used numerically to evaluate a player's goal-scoring clinicalness.

player_attributes.free_kick_accuracy.long: An integer rating ranging from 1 to 97 that indicates a player's skill and accuracy when taking free kicks, with higher values representing greater ability.

player_attributes.gk_diving.long: An integer rating from 1 to 94 representing the player's goalkeeper diving ability. Non-goalkeepers typically score very low (commonly between 6 and 11), whereas specialized goalkeepers have much higher ratings.

player_attributes.gk_handling.long: An integer rating from 1 to 93 representing a player's goalkeeper handling ability. Values are typically concentrated at the lower end (e.g., 7 to 14) for non-goalkeepers, with approximately 0.5% of rows containing NULL values.

player_attributes.gk_kicking.long: This column stores the goalkeeper kicking player attribute, with integer values ranging from 1 to 97 where higher numbers indicate better kicking ability. A small fraction of records (0.45%) contain NULL values.

player_attributes.gk_positioning.short: Goalkeeper positioning skill rating for players
player_attributes.gk_positioning.long: An integer rating between 1 and 96 representing a player's goalkeeper positioning ability, typically sourced from EA Sports FIFA video game statistics. Outfield players populate the most common low values (7 to 14), while actual goalkeepers possess much higher ratings.

player_attributes.gk_reflexes.short: Goalkeeper reflexes rating of the player
player_attributes.gk_reflexes.long: An integer attribute representing the player's goalkeeper reflexes skill, typically rated on a scale from 1 to 99. The observed range of 1 to 96 features a bi-modal distribution, where non-goalkeeper players cluster heavily at very low values (7 to 14) and active goalkeepers score much higher.

player_attributes.heading_accuracy.short: player heading accuracy rating out of 100
player_attributes.heading_accuracy.long: An integer rating from 1 to 98 representing a player's heading accuracy in the football simulation. Approximately 0.5% of rows contain NULL values, and values typically cluster in the high 50s to high 60s.

player_attributes.id.short: Unique primary key for each player attribute snapshot record
player_attributes.id.long: A unique, sequential integer surrogate key that uniquely identifies each record of player attributes. It contains non-null, distinct values ranging sequentially from 1 to 183,978.

player_attributes.interceptions.long: An integer rating ranging from 1 to 96 representing a player's ability to intercept the ball, with approximately 0.5% of rows containing NULL values.

player_attributes.jumping.short: Player jumping ability rating on a 1-99 scale
player_attributes.jumping.long: An integer rating representing a football player's jumping ability, ranging from 14 to 96. This value is likely based on the FIFA video game statistics scale of 1 to 99, with 1% of rows containing NULL values.

player_attributes.long_passing.short: Player's numerical long passing skill rating
player_attributes.long_passing.long: This column represents a player's long passing ability rating, ranging from 3 to 97. The value is stored as an integer, where higher values indicate better passing accuracy and skill over long distances.

player_attributes.long_shots.short: Player rating for long-range shooting accuracy and power
player_attributes.long_shots.long: An integer rating from 1 to 96 reflecting a player's skill in taking long-distance shots. This attribute appears to follow a typical football simulation scale (such as FIFA) where higher values indicate greater proficiency.

player_attributes.marking.long: An integer rating from 1 to 96 representing a player's tactical ability to mark and track opposing players, commonly found in football video games. Values are represented as one- or two-digit integers, with 25 being the most common score.

player_attributes.overall_rating.long: The overall skill rating of a player, ranging from 33 to 94 based on a scale of 100. This column is stored as an integer, allows NULL values, and acts as a general index of the player's overall quality in the database.

player_attributes.penalties.short: Player penalty-taking skill rating on a 1-99 scale
player_attributes.penalties.long: Represents the player's numerical skill rating for taking penalty kicks, ranging from 2 to 96. This integer column contains 836 null values and operates as an attribute score (typically on a standard 1-99 football gaming scale).

player_attributes.player_api_id.short: Unique API identifier for football players
player_attributes.player_api_id.long: A numeric identifier linking attributes to a specific football player. Because this table tracks historical stats, players have multiple records (sharing the same ID) ranging from 2,625 to 750,584.

player_attributes.player_fifa_api_id.short: EA Sports FIFA video game API player identifier
player_attributes.player_fifa_api_id.long: A foreign key containing the unique integer identifier assigned to players in the EA Sports FIFA video game series API. Values range from 2 to 234141, with multiple entries per player representing attribute updates across different game releases.

player_attributes.positioning.short: Player positioning attribute score ranging from 2 to 96
player_attributes.positioning.long: An integer rating from 2 to 96 representing a football player's positional awareness and ability to find space. This attribute contains a small number of null values (less than 1%) and is typically sourced from FIFA video game player statistics.

player_attributes.potential.short: Player potential rating on a scale of 39 to 97
player_attributes.potential.long: An integer rating ranging from 39 to 97 representing a football player's estimated future potential. This rating is typically assessed on a 1-100 scale, contains approximately 0.5% null values, and most frequently clusters in the mid-70s.

player_attributes.preferred_foot.long: Indicates the player's preferred kicking foot, stored as a text enum with two possible lowercase values: 'right' (the majority at approximately 75%) or 'left'. This column contains some NULL values (under 1%).

player_attributes.reactions.long: An integer rating from 17 to 96 representing a football player's reaction speed attributes, where higher values indicate quicker reflexes and cognitive responses on the pitch.

player_attributes.short_passing.short: Player short passing skill rating on a 100-point scale
player_attributes.short_passing.long: This column represents a player's numerical rating for short passing ability, typically scored on a scale from 1 to 100. Actual values range from 3 to 97, with a small percentage (less than 1%) of null entries.

player_attributes.shot_power.short: player shot power rating on a 1-100 scale
player_attributes.shot_power.long: An integer rating from 2 to 97 representing a player's shot power, typically scored on a 1-100 scale. This column contains 836 NULL values out of 183,978 rows.

player_attributes.sliding_tackle.long: An integer rating ranging from 2 to 95 that measures a player's ability to perform sliding tackles, where higher values represent greater skill. Approximately 1% of the rows contain NULL values.

player_attributes.sprint_speed.short: Player sprint speed rating on a 100-point scale
player_attributes.sprint_speed.long: This column stores a player's numerical sprint speed rating, ranging from 12 to 97, where higher values indicate greater speed. It is stored as an integer with approximately 0.5% of the records containing NULL values.

player_attributes.stamina.short: Player stamina rating on a 10-96 scale
player_attributes.stamina.long: This column contains the player's physical stamina rating, represented as a two-digit integer ranging from 10 to 96. Approximately 0.5% of the 183,978 rows are NULL, with values most commonly clustered around the high 60s and low 70s.

player_attributes.standing_tackle.long: An integer rating from 1 to 95 representing a player's standing tackle ability. Approximately 0.5% of rows are null.

player_attributes.strength.long: An integer rating from 10 to 96 representing a player's physical strength, where higher values indicate greater strength. It contains 82 distinct two-digit values and is null for about 0.5% of rows.

player_attributes.vision.short: Player vision rating on a 1-to-97 scale
player_attributes.vision.long: An integer rating representing a football player's pitch vision, ranging from 1 to 97. Approximately 1% of the records contain NULL values for this attribute.

player_attributes.volleys.long: An integer rating from 1 to 93 representing a football player's technical ability to execute volleys. Approximately 1% of the records contain NULL values, with higher scores indicating superior skill.

team.id.short: Unique integer identifier for each football team
team.id.long: Unique integer serving as the primary key for the soccer database's teams. Values range from 1 to 51606 with gaps, representing 299 distinct teams.

team.team_api_id.short: Unique numeric identifier for a football team
team.team_api_id.long: A unique, non-null 4-digit identifier code (ranging from 1601 to 274581) used to represent each football team in the database registry.

team.team_fifa_api_id.short: FIFA API unique identifier for the football team
team.team_fifa_api_id.long: An integer identifier referencing the team's ID in the external FIFA video game database. Values range from 1 to 112513, with some duplicate values and approximately 4% of records containing NULLs.

team.team_long_name.short: Full official names of European football clubs
team.team_long_name.long: This column contains the full, official names of European football clubs, ranging from 2 to 26 characters in length. team.team_short_name.short: Abbreviated two- or three-letter code representing the football team
team.team_short_name.long: This column contains short, often three-letter mnemonic codes or abbreviations (ranging from 'AAR' to 'ZWO') used to represent football teams. It contains no NULL values across its 299 rows, with some non-unique values owing to different teams sharing the same short abbreviation.

team_attributes.buildupplaydribbling.short: Team build-up play dribbling attribute rating
team_attributes.buildupplaydribbling.long: An integer rating between 24 and 77 that measures a team's tendency to dribble during the build-up play phase. Approximately 66% of the records in this column are NULL, which should be accounted for in queries.

team_attributes.buildupplaydribblingclas.short: Team build-up play dribbling frequency classification
team_attributes.buildupplaydribblingclas.long: An categorical attribute indicating how much a team relies on dribbling during their build-up play. It functions as an enum with three possible text values: 'Little' (most common), 'Normal', and 'Lots'.

team_attributes.buildupplaypassing.short: Team buildup play passing capability rating
team_attributes.buildupplaypassing.long: An integer rating ranging from 20 to 80 that represents a team's passing style during buildup play, where lower values typically indicate short-passing preference and higher values indicate long-passing tendencies.

team_attributes.buildupplaypassingclass.short: Tactical passing style classification for team build-up play
team_attributes.buildupplaypassingclass.long: An categorical attribute indicating a team's preferred design and distance of passing during their build-up play. It contains one of three text values representing team tactics: 'Mixed' (predominant with 1,236 occurrences), 'Short', or 'Long'.

team_attributes.buildupplaypositioningcl.long: An organizational classification of a team's positioning during build-up play, representing whether players maintain their positions or move dynamically. This column is a two-value enum with no NULL values, consisting of either 'Organised' (highly dominant, with 1,386 rows) or 'Free Form' (72 rows).

team_attributes.buildupplayspeed.long: A numeric rating representing the speed of a team's build-up play tactics. Values are two-digit integers ranging from 20 to 80, where higher numbers indicate a faster overall transition speed.

team_attributes.buildupplayspeedclass.short: Categorical speed of team buildup play
team_attributes.buildupplayspeedclass.long: A classification of the speed at which a team transitions from defense to attack. This is a text-based enum with three possible values: 'Balanced', 'Fast', and 'Slow'.

team_attributes.chancecreationcrossing.short: Team chance creation crossing rating scale
team_attributes.chancecreationcrossing.long: An integer rating ranging from 20 to 80 that represents a team's tendency or effectiveness in crossing the ball to create goal-scoring opportunities, typically derived from FIFA video game attributes.

team_attributes.chancecreationcrossingcl.short: Categorical rating of a team's crossing frequency during chance creation
team_attributes.chancecreationcrossingcl.long: This column classifies the frequency or emphasis a team places on crossing the ball to create goal-scoring opportunities. It behaves as an ordered categorical text scale (enum) with three possible values: 'Little', 'Normal', and 'Lots'.

team_attributes.chancecreationpassing.short: Team rating for chance creation passing effectiveness
team_attributes.chancecreationpassing.long: A numeric rating representing a team's passing style and tendency when creating goal-scoring opportunities. Values are integers ranging from 21 to 80, with higher values typically indicating more aggressive or creative passing strategies.

team_attributes.chancecreationpassingcla.short: Team chance creation passing risk classification
team_attributes.chancecreationpassingcla.long: An categorical classification of a team's passing risk style when creating chances, represented as a text enum. It contains no NULL values and is restricted to three distinct values: 'Normal', 'Risky', and 'Safe', with 'Normal' being the most common.

team_attributes.chancecreationpositionin.short: tactical class for team chance-creation positioning
team_attributes.chancecreationpositionin.long: An enum-style tactical setting indicating how players position themselves during chance-creation. Features exactly two distinct values: 'Organised' (most common, 1,309 rows) and 'Free Form' (149 rows), with no NULL values.

team_attributes.chancecreationshooting.short: Team chance creation shooting attribute rating
team_attributes.chancecreationshooting.long: An integer rating representing a football team's shooting tendency during chance creation, ranging from 22 to 80. This attribute, likely sourced from FIFA team tactics data, reflects how often a team attempts shots when establishing offensive plays.

team_attributes.chancecreationshootingcl.short: Team chance creation shooting style classification
team_attributes.chancecreationshootingcl.long: An categorical attribute indicating a team's shooting frequency during chance creation. It is represented as a text enum with three possible values: 'Normal' (most common), 'Lots', and 'Little'.

team_attributes.date.short: Date and time of team attribute assessment
team_attributes.date.long: The date and time when the team's attributes were recorded, formatted as a 19-character YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS timestamp string. It contains 6 distinct snapshot dates spanning from February 2010 to September 2015, with no missing values.

team_attributes.defenceaggression.short: Numerical rating of a team's defensive aggression level
team_attributes.defenceaggression.long: An integer metric representing the team's level of aggression on defense, ranging from 24 to 72. This rating is sourced from FIFA video game attributes and is fully populated across all 1458 rows with no NULL values.

team_attributes.defenceaggressionclass.short: Classification of team defensive aggression style
team_attributes.defenceaggressionclass.long: An categorical classification of a team's defensive aggression style, representing how aggressively they pressure the opposition. team_attributes.defencedefenderlineclass.long: A categorical column indicating the team's defensive line tactic, acting as a two-value enum with the possible options 'Cover' (more common, 1,362 rows) and 'Offside Trap' (96 rows).

team_attributes.defencepressure.short: Team defensive pressure rating from 23 to 72
team_attributes.defencepressure.long: An integer fitness rating representing the team's defensive pressure level, ranging from 23 to 72. This value represents tactical attributes likely sourced from EA Sports FIFA video game data, with no null values across all 1,458 team records.

team_attributes.defencepressureclass.short: Categorical defensive line pressure level classification
team_attributes.defencepressureclass.long: This column classifies the team's defensive pressure level into one of three ordered categories: 'Deep', 'Medium', or 'High'. It contains no NULL values across its 1,458 records, with 'Medium' being the most common modern tactical setting.

team_attributes.defenceteamwidth.short: Tactical defense width rating of the team
team_attributes.defenceteamwidth.long: An integer value between 29 and 73 representing the team's tactical defensive width setting. Higher values indicate a wider defensive setup, while lower values indicate a more narrow, compact defensive structure.

team_attributes.defenceteamwidthclass.short: Tactical defense width classification of the team
team_attributes.defenceteamwidthclass.long: A categorical classification indicating how wide a team's defensive line spreads across the pitch. It acts as an enum with three possible text values: 'Normal' (the most common), 'Wide', and 'Narrow'.

team_attributes.id.short: Unique surrogate primary key identifier for each team attribute record
team_attributes.id.long: The unique primary key for each row in the Team_Attributes table. It contains sequential, non-null integer values ranging from 1 to 1458, serving as a surrogate identifier for each recorded set of team attributes.

team_attributes.team_api_id.short: Unique API identifier for European football teams
team_attributes.team_api_id.long: A unique identifier representing a football team, used to link matching records across the database. This column contains 4-to-6 digit numeric IDs containing no null values, ranging from 1601 to 274581.

team_attributes.team_fifa_api_id.short: FIFA division API identifier for the team
team_attributes.team_fifa_api_id.long: An integer identifier referencing the team's record in the official FIFA video game database. Values range from 1 to 112513, contain up to 6 digits, and associate team attributes with specific FIFA game editions.
